scope.purpose: Implementation-validity targets only; never evidence that v5 is superior.
notes: A reported center is kept with its own repository, dataset, configuration and evaluator evidence bundle.
PENDING is used whenever exact seed identities, processed-data revision, checkpoint selection, metric semantics or command-to-center binding is not proven.
No repository, dataset or artifact was cloned or downloaded and no benchmark was executed.

verdict_semantics.PASS: All identity/protocol gates match and every required observed metric lies within its frozen tolerance.
verdict_semantics.FAIL: All identity/protocol gates match, the required execution completed, and at least one required metric is outside tolerance.
verdict_semantics.INCOMPARABLE: A completed or proposed result differs on repository implementation, dataset revision, split, preprocessing, objective/config, checkpoint rule, metric semantics, cutoff, eligible users, relevance, candidate set or run aggregation.
verdict_semantics.PENDING: The run has not occurred or at least one acceptance-critical source field remains unresolved.
